parent_objective: design corrected public pilot after branch synthesis
blocked_by: synthesis continues the branch but requires corrected pilot design before any training
supersedes: M1199-style comparison without current-tiled controls or corrected reset semantics
invalidates: claiming finite-window history benefit without current-tiled capacity controls

public_gates: M1206 may design the corrected public pilot only
M1206 must not run candidate replay
M1206 must not use private holdout
M1206 must not claim profile superiority or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim performance evidence from design
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_corrected_profile_pilot_design: corrected controls under fixed protocol
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers the corrected public pilot after synthesis reset the branch cadence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if pilot lacks current-tiled L2 controls
stop if pilot lacks corrected L3 reset semantics
stop if budgets or seeds differ per profile
stop if private holdout would be used
fallback_plan: route to corrected config generation if configs are missing
route to smoke repair if controls cannot be applied in generated configs
route to profile repair if corrected pilot cannot be made fair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1205 branch synthesis decision is continue

blocked_shortcuts: do not train controllers in M1206
do not make performance or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review
next_stage_criteria: shared seeds budgets and eval rules are fixed
next config-generation or pilot-run milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1206 designs current-tiled controls to test current-frame substitution but does not itself produce self-ID evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Design only; later pilot may evaluate temporal evidence on public seeds.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If corrected controls do not separate profiles later, route to task/profile design rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A corrected public pilot can be designed with current-tiled L2 controls and corrected L3 reset semantics under fixed budgets.
success_criteria: corrected profile set, seeds, budgets, eval rules, metrics, artifacts, and claim scope are fixed
no training, PPO, candidate replay, promotion, private holdout, per-profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
next config-generation or pilot-run milestone is selected
failure_criteria: design omits current-tiled L2 controls or corrected reset semantics
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced

commands.name: design_corrected_profile_pilot
commands.command: write corrected public pilot design without training

decision_rule: M1206 passes if it pre-registers the corrected public pilot without training, tuning, promotion, private holdout, or claim expansion.
